2012: Rio+20 Conference laid foundation for SDGs.

passage_flags.claim: Farmers, water managers and planners therefore watch the monsoon closely every year.
passage_flags.problem: Not stated in the booklet text; it is an added inference about who monitors the monsoon.

passage_flags.claim: Passenger services and station projects all depend on the same network, so planning must cover many needs at once.
passage_flags.problem: Not stated in the booklet text; the 'planning must cover many needs' conclusion is an added inference.

passage_flags.claim: Because the fault is active, engineers must consider the possibility of movement near a dam that would hold back a great volume of water.
passage_flags.problem: The booklet notes the fault is active and the reservoir area is crossed by it, but does not say engineers must consider movement near the dam.

passage_flags.claim: Any decision to build a dam on its upper course therefore has effects far beyond the project site.
passage_flags.problem: Not stated in the booklet text; downstream or transboundary effects of the dam are not described.

passage_flags.claim: Such a project should be judged carefully, with clear answers on the stability of the fault and the safety of nearby communities, before construction moves forward.
passage_flags.problem: Normative recommendation not found in the booklet text.

passage_flags.claim: Local residents and officials would need reliable information before any such decision is taken.
passage_flags.problem: Normative statement not found in the booklet text.
